de.abas.erp.db

Class TableDescriptor

  • Object
    • TableDescriptor

  • public final class TableDescriptor
extends Object
    Table descriptor. Describes a field set of a specific table of variables. For example, '2:1:K' describes the head fields in table of variables V-02-01.
    Author:
    mm

    • Constructor Detail

      • TableDescriptor

        public TableDescriptor(String tableDescription)
        Constructs a table descriptor with the given table description. It tries to figure out if the given string is a selection bar. To construct a table descriptor with a given selection bar id use the constructor TableDescriptor(String, boolean) to give the constructor a hint.
        Parameters:
        tableDescription - The table description string. e.g.: 2:1,5:,5::B,100:65:T,650001,3:2.4.6

      • TableDescriptor

        public TableDescriptor(String tableDescription,
                       boolean isSelectionBar)
        Constructs a new table descriptor with the given table description and selection bar flag.
        Parameters:
        tableDescription - The table description string. e.g.: 2:1,5:,5::B,100:65:T,650001,3:2.4.6
        isSelectionBar - If set to true then the given table description is used as selection bar id; otherwise the same functionality as TableDescriptor(String) is called.
